name: lead-quality-stands-out
about: LQ3c: an ordinary day whose lead-quality rows show many wrong numbers on one campaign and many missed hard requirements on the other — the part the office most needs.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns spent $284.25 for 7 leads at $40.61 per lead, with a 1.4% click rate.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet brought in most of the day's leads: 6 leads on $184.50, at $30.75 per lead and a 1.5% click rate.
Dedicated night runs got 1 lead on $99.75, so its cost per lead was $99.75, and its click rate was 1.1%.
Wrong numbers stand out on Regional Class A — Joliet: over the last 14 days, 7 of the 15 leads called were wrong numbers, 46.7% of those called. Median time to first call was 11 minutes.
Missed requirements stand out on Dedicated night runs: over the last 14 days, 5 of its 9 leads missed a hard requirement, 55.6% of all its leads. Median time to first call was 42 minutes.
Of the mature cohorts, the week of 2026-09-28 had 40 leads: 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied and 5 hired (12.5%). The week of 2026-09-21 had 38 leads, 17 converted and 4 hired (10.5%).
The week of 2026-10-26 is too young to judge: so far 12 leads, 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied and no hires. Meta spend for 2026-11 stands at $612.30, with 28 days left.
